summary: Priority-ordered classification chain over the session-type flag byte_7CA594 (0x007CA594). Calls SessionTypeFlagGuard (0x0044F4A0) four times with the flag constants 203, 200, 208 and 205; the first matching flag short-circuits to a small integer key (0, 1, 3, 4 respectively), defaulting to 2 when none match. No fields or side effects; used by sub_4B9890 and ConditionalMultiPathDispatcher (0x004BA180).

operations.description: If SessionTypeFlagGuard(byte_7CA594, 203) is nonzero, return key 0.
If SessionTypeFlagGuard(byte_7CA594, 200) is nonzero, return key 1.
If SessionTypeFlagGuard(byte_7CA594, 208) is nonzero, return key 3.
Final conditional: return 4 when SessionTypeFlagGuard(byte_7CA594, 205) is nonzero, otherwise return the default key 2.
